neighbours.label: The token where an opening parenthesis runs straight into an opening square bracket or curly brace ('([' or '({'), when that parenthesis is NOT a function call's argument list; strongest inside regular-expression patterns, weaker but present in plain prose, math and string literals. Function calls taking a list or dict (sum([...]), f({...})), regex groups without a bracket like (\w+), and a bracket or parenthesis on its own stay quiet.
neighbours.short: '([' / '({' as a grouping paren (not a call), strongest in regex

The grep expression '([[:alpha:]]+)' extracts every word from the log.
